verdict.rationale: Shopify's Global Catalog MCP server lets agents search products across multiple merchants, and the documented Anonymous/Signed tiers plus a self-generated UCP profile mean no partnership is needed. Probes confirm a keyless handshake and a keyless CLI catalog search using a self-generated local profile. The one documented gate is that every search request must carry an agent profile URL, which is self-service. Missing for 10: a hands-on, keyless, cross-merchant search_catalog result returned through a self-hosted profile (the probe search ran on one merchant's store), and published Anonymous-tier rate-limit figures.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can programmatically search products or services across merchants — keylessly or with self-service credentials, no private partnership required

citations.quote: The Global Catalog MCP server enables AI agents to search and discover products across the entire Shopify ecosystem, helping buyers find products from multiple merchants.
UCP traffic to Shopify's MCP servers is classified into three tiers based on how your agent identifies itself
@shopify/ucp-cli with a self-generated local profile searched the live catalog
a keyless JSON-RPC initialize POST to https://catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp completed a FULL handshake
